capabilities: Browse daily notes in a grouped list tree by year, month, quarter, or week
Show notes and attachments created on each day by file creation time
Assign custom titles and 8-color tags to day rows
Generate note titles and descriptions via a local Ollama model
Adjust zoom, sorting, word-count filtering, and persisted view state
extras: The manifest carries an 'not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff' notice. Title generation sends note text to a local Ollama server; the model gemma3:4b is downloaded from Ollama's registry on first pull.
problem: Obsidian's daily notes lack a calendar-style overview with grouping, day-level metadata, and a way to see what was created on each day.
summary: Calendar view for daily notes that adds a grouped list view, custom titles, color tags, and optional local LLM title generation.
